input.title: 20bb · Flop · Jack-high clubs
input.description: A saved flop-to-river game on Jc 7c 2d at 20bb starting depth, with a 12bb pot and 14bb behind. Broad weighted ranges include sets, overpairs, top pair, two pair, and club draws. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative per-combination inclusion multipliers: BTN AA x1, QQ x0.75, AJo x0.75, KJs x0.75, QJs x0.5, T9s x0.5; BB JJ x1, 77 x1, 22 x1, J7s x0.75, KJo x0.5, A7s x0.75, 98s x0.75, 65s x0.5. Weights describe range inclusion, not action frequencies. Board blockers are removed before normalization; private cards are drawn jointly with exact card removal. Priors are declared assumptions, not certified preflop frequencies. All later betting and ordered card arrivals belong to one conditional flop-to-river game, not a full-hand solution or a replacement for the live 20bb solver. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
